ordered_steps: Update pyproject.toml dependency from pydantic>=1.8,<2 to pydantic>=2,<3

Migrate src/pydantic_yaml/mixin.py: replace pydantic v1 imports (BaseModel, ModelMetaclass, BaseConfig, validator, parse.Protocol, load_file, load_str_bytes, error_wrappers.ErrorWrapper, ValidationError, types.StrBytes, types.SecretStr, types.SecretBytes, typing imports) with pydantic v2 equivalents (BaseModel, ConfigDict, field_validator/model_validator, model.parse_file/model.parse_raw, ValidationError, SecretStr, SecretBytes, typing imports)
Migrate src/pydantic_yaml/model.py: update YamlModel to inherit from pydantic.BaseModel (v2 compatible) and adjust any Config class to model_config
Migrate src/pydantic_yaml/compat/hacks.py: replace pydantic.types and pydantic.networks imports with v2-compatible type discovery (pydantic.types.__all__ may not exist; use getattr on known types)
Migrate src/pydantic_yaml/ext/semver.py: replace pydantic.errors import with pydantic.ValidationError
Migrate src/pydantic_yaml/ext/versioned_model.py: replace pydantic.validator with pydantic.field_validator
Migrate src/pydantic_yaml/compat/types.py: ensure YamlStr/YamlInt/YamlStrEnum/YamlIntEnum work with pydantic v2 type system (register_str_like/register_int_like may need updates for v2 YAML dumping)
Update src/pydantic_yaml/main.py and src/pydantic_yaml/__init__.py exports if any v1-specific re-exports change
strategies.rationale: Smallest complete migration updating only the dependency pin and the source files that directly use Pydantic v1 APIs which are removed or changed in v2. All tests must pass unchanged.
strategies.title: Minimal Pydantic v2 Migration

ordered_steps: Update pyproject.toml dependency to pydantic>=1.8,<3 (allow both v1 and v2)

Create src/pydantic_yaml/compat/pydantic_shim.py with version detection and unified imports: BaseModel, BaseConfig/ConfigDict, validator/field_validator/model_validator, ValidationError, parse APIs, types (StrBytes/SecretStr/SecretBytes), networks, typing utilities
Refactor src/pydantic_yaml/mixin.py to import from compat.pydantic_shim instead of pydantic directly; adapt MRO handling for v1/v2 BaseModel differences
Refactor src/pydantic_yaml/model.py to use compat.pydantic_shim.BaseModel and ConfigDict/model_config compatibility
Refactor src/pydantic_yaml/compat/hacks.py to use compat.pydantic_shim for type discovery (handle missing pydantic.networks in v2)
Refactor src/pydantic_yaml/ext/semver.py to import ValidationError from compat.pydantic_shim
Refactor src/pydantic_yaml/ext/versioned_model.py to use compat.pydantic_shim.field_validator
Refactor src/pydantic_yaml/compat/types.py to register representers compatible with both YAML libraries and pydantic v1/v2 serialization hooks
strategies.rationale: Maintains a compatibility shim so the library works with both pydantic v1 and v2 at runtime. Adds a compat layer for v1 vs v2 methods (validator vs field_validator, BaseConfig vs ConfigDict, ValidationError handling, parse APIs, type imports). All existing tests pass on both v1 and v2.
strategies.title: Pydantic v1/v2 Compatibility Layer Migration

ordered_steps: Update pyproject.toml dependency to pydantic>=2,<3 and drop deprecated, types-Deprecated, importlib_metadata if no longer needed

Rewrite src/pydantic_yaml/mixin.py as a native v2 mixin: inherit from pydantic.BaseModel, use model_config = ConfigDict(...), replace parse_raw/parse_file with model.parse_raw/model.parse_file, replace validator with @field_validator/@model_validator, use SecretStr/SecretBytes from pydantic.types, drop pydantic.networks/typing/error_wrappers imports
Rewrite src/pydantic_yaml/model.py: YamlModel uses model_config, inherits cleanly from BaseModel, yaml()/json() methods delegate to model.model_dump
Rewrite src/pydantic_yaml/compat/hacks.py: remove pydantic.networks dependency, discover string/int-like types via pydantic.types.__all__ or known v2 type list, register representers for YAML dumping
Rewrite src/pydantic_yaml/ext/semver.py: inherit from pydantic.types.StringConstraints or use Annotated[str, ...], use pydantic.ValidationError, drop pydantic.errors
Rewrite src/pydantic_yaml/ext/versioned_model.py: use @field_validator('version', mode='before') instead of @validator('version', always=True), use model_config for version constraints

Rewrite src/pydantic_yaml/compat/types.py: simplify YamlStr/YamlInt/YamlStrEnum/YamlIntEnum using v2 serialization hooks (__get_pydantic_json_schema__, __get_pydantic_serialization__), drop deprecated YamlEnum
Update src/pydantic_yaml/compat/yaml_lib.py to prefer ruamel-new API and drop legacy YAML library branches if unmaintained
strategies.rationale: Rewrites the library to use Pydantic v2 native APIs exclusively: ConfigDict/model_config, field_validator/model_validator, model.parse_* methods, SecretStr/SecretBytes, removed pydantic.networks, removed pydantic.parse.Protocol, removed error_wrappers. Removes deprecated YamlEnum and old compat hacks. All tests pass on v2 only.
strategies.title: Full Pydantic v2 Native Refactor
